title: Tensor compatibility of the raw rational continuous realization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a separated finite-type scheme $T$ over $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, where $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T=B_T[1/\varpi]$, with localization the sheaf colimit of repeated multiplication by $\varpi$. Use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and the raw rationalized category $\mathcal C_E(T)=D^b_c(T,E)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Tensor $\otimes^L_E$ and its unit $\mathbf1_E$ in this category are exactly the completed-integral, rationalized operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $I_{T,E}$ be the finite-stage identity-on-integral-objects equivalence of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison] from $\mathcal C_E(T)$ to the PBC raw rationalization, and let $J^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{T,E}$ be the t-exact continuous-coefficient realization of [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization]. Set $J_{T,E}=J^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{T,E}I_{T,E}$. Its values are bounded complexes of $E_T$-module sheaves with stratified locally finite free cohomology, in the ambient derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$J_{T,E}(P\otimes^L_E Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{T,E}(P)\otimes^L_{E_T}J_{T,E}(Q),\qquad J_{T,E}(\mathbf1_E)\xrightarrow{\sim}E_T[0]$$
for all $P,Q\in\mathcal C_E(T)$. These comparisons make $J_{T,E}$ symmetric strong monoidal: they commute with associators, unitors and the signed symmetry. On integral representatives they are the coefficient-extension comparisons from the completed derived tensor to ordinary derived tensor after localization; on localized arrows $f/\varpi^n$ they use $J(f)/\varpi^n$. They commute with finite field extension $E\subset F$, where on the ambient side extension means $F_T\otimes^L_{E_T}-$ and on the raw rational side it is the scalar extension in [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2) and Remark 6.8.15; tensor-compatible formulation for the specified completed operations. Also Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach Proposition 5.5 and Theorem 7.7 (natural coefficient-extension comparison). The extra coherence assertions are an agent formulation.
